sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000176-P1, was presented by the Supplier to Clearwater Urgent Care 176 on June 15, 2026.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: a Tier 2 rebate of 4.5%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a commitment of 920 Influenza doses per year.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: countered by the Customer.
